mentions.name: Solo house remodel video series
mentions.description: A solo DIY house remodel project — redoing the kitchen and a bathroom, with the house currently stripped of most of its wiring, pipes, insulation, and walls — documented through YouTube short videos.
mentions.source_excerpt: Taking a break from software to remodel a house by myself. The plan was just to redo the kitchen and a bathroom and be done by August, so naturally it's now December here in Minnesota and the house is missing most of its wiring, pipes, insulation, and walls. :) I'm having a great time though and just started producing videos about it
